description: DXC Level 2: build the upstream Microsoft DirectX Shader Compiler (tag v1.10.2605.37) as dxcompiler.dll from the dxc feed through LiberX's existing dxilconv machinery, behind ENABLE_DXCOMPILER_L2, then prove on the LiberNT VM that it compiles Shader Model 6.0-6.6 HLSL to DXIL that the open-source validator accepts, while Level 1 stays intact as the fallback and control.
